scope: Audit Claude's second-pass red-team plus re-check claimed S78 closure against executable G18.

accepted_from_claude_redteam.response: repaired in ChatGPT V66 Stage-4 authority V5 + validator/tests; cross-branch source_commit+git_blob used instead of invalid universal HEAD:path assumption

findings.title: Claude S78 is only partially repaired; G18 does not prove full consumer semantics
evidence: G18 checks T5 rows/pairs, vocabulary, T3/T4 shapes, metacell count, gene/interval/pair counts and pair_gene dtype.
G18 does not verify t3_nnz=6624289 or t4_nnz=55467544 against sparse payloads.
G18 does not recompute/verify aggregate binding 2a540484... over the accepted shard hashes.
G18 checks only that pair_gene has string dtype; it does not prove every pair_gene resolves exactly against the gene dictionary.
G18 does not check pair_interval resolution against the interval dictionary.
AXIS_INTERPRETATION is accepted by presence of t3 text; the executable gate does not demonstrate all declared axis semantics.
findings.consequence: A future executor can pass the current semantic gate while misresolving pair→gene/interval mappings or while sparse payload counts/aggregate identity drift.
required_repair: Recompute T3/T4 nnz from accepted availability payload representation and compare exact counts.
Recompute aggregate binding from the eight accepted shard digests using the frozen Phase-B binding algorithm and compare 2a540484....
Verify every pair_gene resolves to exactly one gene-axis element; reject missing/duplicate/incorrect mapping.
Verify every pair_interval resolves to exactly one interval-axis element using the actual interval identity representation.
Verify metacell IDs are exactly 0..3230 and shard axes/dictionaries agree across all eight shards, not s00 only.
Add mutation/fixture tests for each mapping/count/binding failure. Contract-string mutations alone are insufficient.
